decisions.reason: As a compact dumper closely connected to our existing site-equipment knowledge base, we can absorb customer feedback efficiently through our engineering and service organisation, so withdrawal risk remains low.

The articulated construction dumper sits squarely within our established construction machinery competences, making it easy for us to refine and support with our in-house R&D and installed commercial-service capabilities.

Because the underground mine rescue vehicle remains comparatively distant from our core product knowledge and no strong market validation is visible, the cost of further learning and adaptation is more likely to outweigh the benefits.

This telescopic loader line builds directly on our existing machinery platform and the multi-model rollout signals enough accumulated know-how and commitment to continue improving it rather than exit.
The material lift line is close to our established lifting offer and the reported rental popularity and large order provide exactly the kind of market feedback we can readily absorb and scale.

Although the compact underground mining loader is more distant from our traditional offer, the reported heavy early operating hours give us valuable real-use learning that our engineering team can convert into improvement, so we keep it with some caution.
